name: Storm
blurb: Thunder is scheduled first; the strike lands 80 ms behind it. Light beats sound to an observer in the real world, so leading with audio is physically right.

name: Séance
blurb: Four organ chords, 7.5 s each, overlapping so nothing fully releases. The second is the Neapolitan — a major triad a semitone above the tonic.

name: Ballroom
blurb: The parlour waltz — music box over piano, three-four time. All three zones drift slowly between violet and green.

name: Descent
blurb: A 32-foot pedal holds for the whole piece while the upper voices walk down chromatically. One strike per chord change, nothing hurried.

name: Visitation
blurb: Candles gutter out, both towers drift to a cold breathing green, and something watches from the left window.

name: Approach
blurb: What the walkway sensor fires. Total blackout, a beat of nothing, then the door goes up like a furnace.

name: Crypt
blurb: Below the castle. A heartbeat at 48 bpm, a tritone drone underneath, and whispers just past intelligibility. The lights barely admit anything is there — near-darkness is the effect.
